## 2. Literary Biography & Background
Rahul Sebastian is an engineer (B.E EEE) and contemporary Tamil poet from Erode, Tamil Nadu, India. Honored with the Best Engineering Student Award (2019) by Erode Civil Engineers Association, he synthesizes analytical engineering precision with deep Tamil philosophical verse.

Deeply inspired by legendary Tamil literary master Manushyaputhiran (மனுஷ்யபுத்திரன்), Rahul Sebastian authored his maiden Tamil poetry book 'Ennangalin Kuppai Koodam' (எண்ணங்களின் குப்பைக் கூடம்) published by Nerpadapesu Publication (நேர்படப் பேசு பதிப்பகம்) in 2026. The book won the International Winner World Records for Book 2026 award.
